title: 3D
summary: 3D scenes built only from lines of light: every line has a white core with a red echo up-left and a blue echo down-right in screen space, a soft lilac glow, and fades into the near-black teal haze with depth. Red marks the cause, blue the result. Pass "clear": true to float a scene over footage (transparent canvas).

items.name: Wire tunnel
items.description: Flying down a tunnel of light rings along eight rails; a red pulse runs away down one rail and lands blue at the vanishing point. Loops.

items.name: Grid horizon
items.description: A grid of light streaming to the horizon under a rising sun made of banded lines and rays. Loops.

items.name: Light beam
items.description: Floor lines meet at an apex, a red line climbs to it and a fan of fine rays bursts upward into a beam. A title backdrop.

items.name: Torus of light
items.description: A wire torus whose rings open one by one, turning slowly; a red spark runs the main ring and flashes blue at the front. Loops.

items.name: Wire globe
items.description: A turning wire globe (no countries); a red point fires arcs that rise off the surface and land in blue flashes. Loops.

items.name: Orbit ribbons
items.description: Tilted orbits round a wire core with comets of light running them; the red inner comet makes the core flash blue each lap. Loops.

items.name: Light strands
items.description: Braided strands of light drawing on and twisting; a red pulse runs one strand and lands blue at its end. Loops.
